title: 普通人应该自信

coverage.excluded_asr_tail: S00061 crosses the audited 109.226667-second endpoint; S00062-S00063 are wholly beyond it. S00061-S00063 are excluded from claims and timeline evidence.

timeline.summary: He recounts an unverified date conversation in which a woman calls him an insulting label for an ordinary but confident man, and he replies by applying the label back to her.
He insults people who use such labels as unintelligent and recommends attacking the statement back, then says arguing cannot persuade someone committed to a position.
He says people's judgments follow their social position and interests and generalizes the reported woman's words as female self-interest.
Using nonstandard philosophical language, he says objectivity is valuable but impossible in full and calls for selective materialism.
He says important decisions centered on one's own interests may be handled idealistically; the repeated ASR continuation crossing the media cut is excluded.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He recounts replying to a woman's insult about an ordinary but confident man by applying an equivalent label to her.
claims.conditions: Unverified self-report; the other participant is absent and her words, identity and reaction are not independently established.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He characterizes users of the label as lacking independent thought and intelligence and recommends directly attacking the statement back.
claims.conditions: Insult-based escalation is not suitable as action advice; disagreement can be ended without demeaning the other person.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He says people reason from their position and interests and extends the reported woman's statement into a generalization about female interests.
claims.conditions: A broad gender and motive attribution without evidence; it cannot determine any individual's reasoning.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He advocates what he calls selective materialism for ordinary tasks but says one may be idealistic when personal interests are central.
claims.conditions: His idiosyncratic terminology is internally underexplained and should not be treated as standard philosophy or a license to disregard facts.

speaker_attribution.speaker: Mikey
speaker_attribution.basis: One visible channel host speaks throughout.

speaker_attribution.speaker: reported woman

visual_findings: All 36 sampled frames show the same black-shirt host seated at a microphone with editorial subtitles.
No woman, date exchange, source text or independent reaction is shown.

permissions.reason: Usable themes are already represented in formal live-037 and EIcItpA_RZU; novel wording consists mainly of gender hostility, an unverified third-party exchange and an underexplained philosophy claim.

limitations: No same-passage parent source was located; reuse is semantic rather than identity reuse.
Automatic ASR crosses the media endpoint, and the last three SIDs are excluded.
The reported conversation and its outcome have no independent evidence.
